author: KEXP
description: On his debut album 'MALIK', South London saxophonist and producer Venna weaves together a silky blend of jazz, soul, Bossa Nova, R&B, and hip hop. He brings this sonic universe to the KEXP Live Room with a performance of "Eternal Reflections" and more.
title: Venna performs "Eternal Reflections" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG presents Venna performing live in the KEXP studio. Recorded February 11, 2026.

Songs:  
Numero Uno 00:22
June's Cry 05:36
Sicily' Box 13:37
Eternal Reflections 19:18

Malik Venner - Sax
Jacob McGibbon - Guitar
Paul Reinhold - Bass
Dominique Gervais - Drums
Idris Frederick - Keys

Host: Noel Brass Jr.
Audio Engineer: Kevin Suggs
